EVENT BATTLE\nFight Off the Black Knights!
My family own this land for generations!\nYou guys dump garbage, ruin my fields, and\nnow you're gonna take my home?!
This land now belongs to our Empire.\nWe can do whatever we like! If you don't leave,\nwe'll execute you all for treason right here!!
Nooo!!
No! Gotta help 'em!!
Grrraaahh!!
Phew, that was close.\nAre you alright?
Whoa?! You're...
Hey, it's you! Been a while!!
What are you doing here?
You saw it right?\nI'm protecting people from Lyark as a partisan.
Why here?
This place used to be a town where the Diels and\nother tribes lived together.
But soon after the Diels migrated out of the town,\nUltimea the city-state of Lyark Empire unilaterally\nclaimed it as their land.
They dump waste generated in Ultimea and plunder\npeople's money, turning the town into a slum.
I was shocked to hear about it from one of my old\nfriends in the town.
Then the person who led our migration told me to\nhelp people out. That's why I came back.
We formed a partisan army with the residents and\nwe're fighting against Lyark...
Grrrrr...
What's wrong, Mochelo?
B-Black knights!!
What? Again?!\n3 fake black knights this time, huh...?
Whoaaa?!
We know someone is claiming to be a black knight...\nHowever, only the soldiers in the elite troops are\nallowed to call themselves Black Knights.
The word "fake" is for those insolent people who\nimpersonate the black knights in the\ncountryside...
Don't get carried away just because you beat\nLyark soldiers. Annoying flies like you must be\nexterminated immediately...
What...?! Flies?! How dare you!
We didn't come here for such a stupid thing.\nLet's just get it over with...!
Dammit! ...They're strong...
What?!
Agh! Always acts up when we're almost done!!
We've no choice. Retreat!!
How fortunate...\nNext time you won't be so lucky!!
Aggghhh! How frustrating!!
I just can't beat them... Black knights...
They're like wearing a golem as an armor, so an\nordinary human is no match for their power and\nspeed.
They're so strong, but why didn't they finish us?
That's our only hope. Their armor works like a\nmachine and gives them great power and speed,\nbut...
Its source of energy is limited, so they can't\nfight for a long time and often retreat like that\nbefore finishing us. I feel humiliated though...
Never thought that the energy source problem\nin Einklang would save our lives...
Well, it's good to know that Lyark also has the\nproblem with securing energy source.
I won't let 'em keep beating us!\nI'll teach them a lesson one day!!
Okay, it's dangerous around here, so why not\nstop by our hide-out?
Morning, did you sleep well?
I couldn't sleep on a hard floor.\nIsn't there a cushion or a mat?
Oh, sorry. We never thought that we would have\nguests in such a place. By the way, you guys\nsaw it too, right?
The black knights and Lyark soldiers...\nYou guys know what they were up to there?
The black knights were guarding Lyark soldiers who\nwere trying to force the residents out and occupy\nthe land?
Guarding the soldiers? Listen, black knights are\nthe strongest troop of Lyark. They wouldn't accept\nsuch a small task.
And instead of occupying the land, my fellow said\nthat the Lyark soldiers seemed to be looking for\nsomething...
Something? Like a treasure?!\nTreasure, right?!
I-I have no idea if it's a treasure but...\nThey said they saw the black knights wandering\naround the ruins before Lyark soldiers came so...
Ruins! There are ruins?! There should be a treasure!\nAlright, we'll go check.\nWe'll find out what they were doing there.
Hey! What are you doing?!\nLet's go, now!!
Heh? Um... Okay, thanks...
Great. You're back safe.\nHow were the ruins?
Huh? Wizard cannon?\nThere's such thing left in the ruins?!
So, a huge crysta is needed to fire the wizard\ncannon... A huge crysta?! It's really a treasure!!\n...What?! A factory for that?!
Oh, so you've also got a good eye for valuable\nthings?
Yea, sure. Heh heh.
Don't misunderstand me, okay?\nWe are doing this to disable the magic weapons\nthat could be a big threat to the world! Right?
Yea, right! For the world and for people.
Alright, let's go! Come on, Mochelo?
Hey, over there!!
Too many Demi Machinas!!
W-W-Wh-What're we gonna do?!
I'll back you up!\nShould be enough to defeat them all!!
EVENT BATTLE\nDefeat Demi Machinas!!
Great job. Oh? Where's Triel...?\nYou've always been together, right?
What? Ah, y-yea. We're traveling separately\nfor now...What's the problem?\nSometimes we also need some time to ourselves!
I-I didn't say it was wrong.\nBy the way, why did you come to help us?
A resident in Einklang asked me to find the\nstronghold of the robots or something, so I went\nto Peligro Landfill ahead of Singolare Ruins.
So, did you find something?
Yup. Just as I expected.\nThere was a strange building in the waste pile.
The robots were walking around the building, so\nI couldn't see what's inside...
The strange building that Balft found should be\nthe factory of Demi Machinas!
You need a guide? Yea, I can.\n...You say you're gonna attack the stronghold?\nGreat! Let's do it!
Then, I'll go with you.\nThey're also a threat to us partisans.\nI've gotta get rid of 'em.
What?! You think we're a drag on you?!
The battle started all of a sudden, so we didn't\nhave time to tell you this.
A messenger sent by King Elbano of the Resistle\nfaction is coming to see you partisans.
Huh? A messenger sent by the King?!
Yup. So, we need you as the leader of the partisan\nto discuss the plan to form a coalition with\nthe Resistle faction.
Whaaaat?!\nI have to play such an important role?!\nW-W-What should I do...?!
It's gonna be all right.\nYou've been leading the partisans, right?
The King recognized that you're skilled as the\nleader and decided to send the messenger.\nJust be confident!
I-Is that so...? Mmm, okay.\nI'll see the messenger with the members.\nBut, are you guys alright?
No worries. The adventurer and I will handle it.\nWe'll take those guys down and make sure they\nwon't attack for the second time!
Got it. You can count on me for the coalition\nwith the king. Be careful.
Okay! Now, follow me!\nThis way!!
